note: Milestone-1 parameter catalog. admissible_range states the constraints enforced by validation; recommended_range is unenforced illustrative guidance (recommended_is_enforced is always false). Pressure is gauge pressure in Pa (0 = atmosphere).

R.description: Basket inner radius (radial extent, r in [0, R])
R.provenance_detail: Typical 58 mm basket; uncalibrated example geometry.

L.description: Bed thickness (axial extent, z in [0, L], z increasing downward)
L.provenance_detail: Uncalibrated example bed depth for the default dose/grind.

Nr.description: Number of cell-centered finite volumes in the radial direction
Nr.provenance_detail: Numerical setting; refinement studies use up to 80.

Nz.description: Number of cell-centered finite volumes in the axial direction
Nz.provenance_detail: Numerical setting; refinement studies use up to 160.

R_perf.description: Perforated radius of the bottom plate: bottom columns with cell-center r < R_perf are held at p_out; remaining rim has zero normal flux. R_perf = R means a fully open bottom; R_perf = 0 is a valid sealed bed.
R_perf.provenance_detail: Configurable basket-hole layout; example values are illustrative. A positive R_perf that resolves to zero open columns is rejected (see grid docs).

mu.provenance_detail: IAPWS water transport correlations (Wagner & Pruss 2002; Huber et al. 2009): saturated-liquid water is ~0.31 mPa s at 90 C and ~0.28 at 100 C; 0.30 mPa s is representative. Coffee-liquid viscosity is unmeasured here.

k0.description: Reference permeability: uniform value in uniform mode; value at reference porosity phi0 in compaction mode
k0.provenance_detail: Order-of-magnitude placeholder; no bed-permeability measurement is used.

p_in.description: Inlet gauge pressure imposed at the top (z = 0)
p_in.provenance_detail: Operating point of each run/sweep point, not a material property.

p_out.description: Outlet gauge pressure imposed on the perforated part of the bottom (0 = discharging to atmosphere)
p_out.provenance_detail: Operating point; atmospheric discharge is the default.

permeability_mode.provenance_detail: uniform = verification; compaction = investigative closure with uncalibrated coefficients.

sigma_eff_top.description: Prescribed effective axial stress at the top boundary (pack load carried by the grain skeleton at the inlet)

sigma_c.description: Characteristic effective stress of the exponential porosity law; smaller values mean stronger compaction
sigma_c.provenance_detail: Uncalibrated; controls where the Q(p) rollover sets in.

phi_min.description: Minimum (fully compacted) porosity; lower bound of the porosity law, keeps permeability strictly positive
phi_min.provenance_detail: Placeholder; controls the high-pressure flow asymptote and solver stiffness.

tol_p_rel.description: Picard convergence tolerance: pressure update relative to the imposed pressure difference

tol_p_atol_Pa.description: Picard convergence tolerance: absolute floor for the pressure update
tol_p_atol_Pa.provenance_detail: Numerical setting; required for equal-pressure equilibria.

tol_q_rel.description: Picard convergence tolerance: outlet-flow update, relative with an absolute flow floor

tol_res_rel.description: Picard convergence tolerance: local/global mass balance relative to max(|Q_in|, |Q_out|)
tol_res_rel.provenance_detail: Numerical setting; a solver tolerance, not a discretization error.

max_iter.description: Maximum Picard iterations for the pressure/permeability coupling

relaxation.description: Picard relaxation factor applied to the permeability update (1 = no relaxation)
relaxation.provenance_detail: Numerical setting; tiny values converge arbitrarily slowly and must report nonconvergence, not success.

linear_solver.description: Sparse linear solver for the assembled pressure system (fixed in milestone 1; SPD system, direct SuperLU)

mode.description: Transport mode: extraction (lumped solid pool + exchange) or tracer (passive, no solid pool)
mode.provenance_detail: No measured shot data is used; extraction parameters are unvalidated.

M_dose.description: Dry coffee dose assigned uniformly by cell bulk volume
M_dose.provenance_detail: Example dose; not inferred from the porosity field.

f_sol.description: Accessible soluble mass fraction of the dry dose (input, not predicted)

exchange_rate.provenance_detail: Phenomenological rate; uncalibrated. Zero disables exchange.

K.description: Equilibrium solid solute mass fraction per liquid concentration
K.provenance_detail: Reversible-partition coefficient; K=0 is irreversible first-order release. Uncalibrated.

D.provenance_detail: Molecular-diffusion scale placeholder; uncalibrated. Zero disables dispersion.

rho_solution.description: Cup solution density closure (constant; solute mass is not added again)
rho_solution.provenance_detail: Approximate physical closure, not composition-dependent density.

t_end.description: Final transport time; t=0 is an already wetted bed
t_end.provenance_detail: Numerical/experimental run length, not a material property.

dt.description: Requested time step (shortened at schedule breakpoints and t_end)
dt.provenance_detail: Numerical setting; assess by refinement, not by implicit stability.

cfl_advective.description: Conservative advective accuracy-limit factor on dt; 0 disables

C_inlet.description: Inlet concentration before the first schedule breakpoint

C_in_schedule.description: Inlet concentration schedule as [[t_s, C_kgm3], ...], piecewise constant
C_in_schedule.provenance_detail: Tracer boundary input; extraction requires all zeros.
